issue: Build instructions lacked SDK version compatibility documentation, causing 2 avoidable debugging rounds

1_LoadDataRepeatParam.error: LoadDataRepeatParam constructor requires 3 arguments, but 4 were provided
1_LoadDataRepeatParam.root_cause: Old API (< 9.0.0 beta.2) uses 4-arg braced init. The staged source had a version conditional #if ASC_DEVKIT_VERSION_NUM >= 90000000 but this macro was not defined in standalone compilation, so the old API branch was taken.
1_LoadDataRepeatParam.fix_applied: Removed conditional, directly used new API SetLoadDataRepeatWithStride({0, 1, 0, dstStride})
1_LoadDataRepeatParam.question: Why wasn't this documented? The source code itself has the version conditional — Codex should have flagged that ASC_DEVKIT_VERSION_NUM needs to be defined or the conditional needs to be handled in staging.

2_ASCENDC_TPL_MIX_AIC_1_1.root_cause: Template constant was in the excluded host header. The staging manifest listed it as 'remaining_template_symbol_tokens_to_verify' but didn't provide the actual value.
2_ASCENDC_TPL_MIX_AIC_1_1.fix_applied: Created qsfa_device_template_constants.h with ASCENDC_TPL_MIX_AIC_1_1=4 (= KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1 from bisheng header)
2_ASCENDC_TPL_MIX_AIC_1_1.question: Manifest listed the symbols but didn't give values. We had to find the value ourselves from the compiler header.

request: Please include README-style documentation with build instructions that covers:
documentation_needed: 1. Required SDK version and how to verify (CANN version, ASC_DEVKIT_VERSION_NUM value)
2. Known API version incompatibilities (old vs new API conditionals in source)
3. Template constants that need device-safe definitions (with actual values, not just symbol names)
5. Expected include paths and their sources
6. Common pitfalls and their symptoms (so agents can self-diagnose)
suggestion: Add a BUILD_NOTES.md or SDK_COMPATIBILITY.md to the repo that documents all known SDK version requirements and API compatibility issues. This prevents agents from spending debugging cycles on known issues.
